reflect.off_course: What didn't go to plan today?
reflect.proud_of: What's something you feel quietly proud of today?
reflect.learned: What did you pick up today, big or small?
reflect.surprised: Did anything catch you by surprise today?
reflect.hardest_moment: What was the hardest part of today, and how did you get through it?
reflect.energy: What lifted your energy today, and what took some of it away?
reflect.would_redo: If you had today again, is there anything you'd gently do differently?
reflect.avoided: What have you been putting off? No judgement, just notice it.
reflect.turning_point: Was there a moment today when the day shifted? Jot it down.
reflect.habit_win: Tell the page about a habit you kept today. How did it feel?
reflect.time_well_spent: Which part of the day felt like time well spent?
reflect.stuck_on: What's got you stuck at the moment? Write it out and see.
reflect.someone_helped: Who lent you a hand today, or who did you help along?
reflect.change_mind: Is there something you've come round on lately?
reflect.old_self: If you could leave a note for yourself a year ago, what would it say?
gratitude.small_win: What's one small thing you want to remember?
gratitude.person: Who are you glad is in your life? Say a little about why.
gratitude.comfort: What little comfort did you enjoy today? A warm drink, a soft jumper?
gratitude.unexpected: What was a lovely surprise today?
gratitude.body: What did your body do well for you today?
gratitude.place: Where have you felt good lately? Describe the place.
gratitude.skill: What can you do that you're glad you learned?
gratitude.taste: What was the nicest thing you ate or drank today?
gratitude.kindness: What kindness did you notice today, given or received?
gratitude.challenge: What's a tricky thing that's quietly teaching you something?
gratitude.morning: What was the best part of this morning?
gratitude.tech: What tool or gadget made life a bit easier today?
gratitude.nature: What did you notice outdoors today: a bird, a cloud, some leaves?
gratitude.memory: What happy memory drifted back to you today?
gratitude.tomorrow: What's something small to look forward to tomorrow?
goals.tomorrow: What would make tomorrow a good day?
goals.this_week: What would you like this week to hold for you?
goals.one_thing: If you only did one thing next, what would it be?
goals.first_step: What's one tiny first step you could take on something big?
goals.obstacle: What's standing in your way, and is there a gentler way round it?
goals.habit_next: Is there a habit you'd like to try next?
goals.stop_doing: Is there something you'd like to do a little less of?
goals.month_ahead: Picture a month from now. Where would you like to be?
goals.stretch: What's something that would stretch you, just a little?
goals.who_help: Who might be glad to help with something you're working towards?
goals.finish: What's one thing you'd like to see through to the end?
goals.learn: What are you curious to learn about?
goals.rest_plan: When will you next rest properly, and what will that look like?
goals.big_picture: Why does today's effort matter to you in the long run?
goals.tiny_win: What's one tiny win you could tuck in tomorrow?
wellbeing.mood_word: How are you feeling? Pick just one word.
wellbeing.body_check: Take a moment. How is your body feeling?
wellbeing.sleep: How did you sleep, and what might help tonight?
wellbeing.stress: What's been weighing on you? You can set it down here.
wellbeing.recharge: What helps you feel like yourself again?
wellbeing.boundaries: Did you protect your time today, or is there a boundary you'd like to set?
wellbeing.breath: Pause and take a slow breath. What do you notice?
wellbeing.move: How did you move today, even a little?
wellbeing.screen_time: How did your screens leave you feeling today?
wellbeing.connection: Who did you spend time with today, in person or otherwise?
wellbeing.fuel: How did you look after yourself with food and drink today?
wellbeing.worry_park: Is there a worry you can leave on this page for tonight?
wellbeing.joy: Write down a moment that made you smile today.
wellbeing.kind_self: What would you say to a friend who felt like you do? Say it to yourself.
wellbeing.pause: Did you take a breather today? What did it do for you?
